purpose: Shared schema for EnergyBridge role-play LLM onboarding and human user preference survey.
notes: The same question IDs and option IDs should be used for role-play LLM onboarding and human survey collection.
EnergyBridge may consume natural-language answers, but selected_option_ids make human/LLM calibration easier.
The short human form uses the same four core items and one optional overall constraint note; per-item explanations are not required.

questions.question_en: During a one-hour VPP peak event, what should the home prioritize: comfort and routine, bill savings, grid support, or a balance?
questions.question_zh: 当系统建议你在 1 小时 VPP 高峰事件中减少用电时，家庭应该优先考虑什么？

options.label_zh: 舒适和日常 routine 优先

options.label_en: Clear explanation and confirmation before changes

questions.question_en: If the home remains safe, how much temporary AC setpoint change would you usually accept during a peak event?
questions.question_zh: 如果安全没有问题，在 VPP 高峰事件中，你通常能接受多大的临时空调设定温度变化？

options.label_zh: 几乎不能接受，约 0.5°C 或更小
可以接受约 1°C，但必须时间较短

options.label_en: Around 1-2C if savings or grid benefit are clear
options.label_zh: 如果收益清楚，可以接受约 1-2°C

options.label_en: Larger changes when unoccupied or routine is unaffected
options.label_zh: 家里没人或不影响 routine 时可以接受更大变化

questions.question_en: Can the system automatically shift washer, dishwasher, water-heater, or EV timing when deadlines are protected, or should it ask first?
questions.question_zh: 对于洗衣机、洗碗机、热水器、电动车充电这类设备，如果完成期限能保证，系统可以自动调整时间吗，还是必须先问你？

options.label_en: Do not move without explicit approval
options.label_zh: 未经明确同意不要调整

options.label_en: Can shift by 1-2 hours if deadlines are protected
options.label_zh: 可以提前或推迟 1-2 小时，但必须按时完成

options.label_en: Can shift to cheaper periods if readiness is protected
options.label_zh: 可以移到更便宜的时段，但可用性必须保证

questions.question_en: Which calendar or household routines should not be disturbed, especially around evening arrival, meals, showers, caregiving, or sleep?
questions.question_zh: 哪些日程或家庭 routine 不应该被打扰？尤其是傍晚回家、吃饭、洗澡、照护、睡眠或工作安排。

options.label_zh: 回家时的舒适必须保证

options.label_en: Meals and household chores must not be disrupted
options.label_zh: 吃饭和固定家务安排不能被打乱

options.label_en: Shower and hot-water timing must be protected
options.label_zh: 洗澡和热水时间必须保证

options.label_en: Caregiving, sleep, or work routines must be protected
options.label_zh: 照护、睡眠或工作安排必须保证

options.label_en: Schedule changes often; confirm same-day before acting
options.label_zh: 日程经常变，当天行动前最好再次确认
